#Text Extractor

This notebook takes a large block of text from Proquest, containing 500 peer-reviewed articles, and extracts them to individual text files and builds a dataframe.

Extract the full text of each ProQuest article into its own .txt file
Each article starts with a line of underscores followed by "Document X of 500". For every article, the text from "Full text:" up to
(but not including) "Subject:" is saved to extracted_articles/<headline>.txt

This is based on a workflow from 2019 when we investigated media coverage of Chinese companies.

# Load libraries

```{r}
#install.packages("devtools")
library(tidyverse)

```
#Create extractor in a loop function
```{r}
# Make a headline safe to use as a file name
safe_filename <- function(x, max_chars = 150) {
  x %>%
    str_replace_all('[\\\\/:*?"<>|\\r\\n\\t]', " ") %>%  # characters not allowed in file names
    str_squish() %>%
    str_sub(1, max_chars) %>%                           # keep paths under OS limits
    str_remove("[ .]+$")                                # no trailing spaces/dots (Windows)
}

# Pull headline, year, document number and full text out of one article
extract_one <- function(lines) {

  # Document number ("Document 1 of 500")
  doc_idx <- str_which(lines, "^\\s*Document \\d+ of \\d+")[1]
  if (is.na(doc_idx)) return(NULL)
  doc_num <- as.integer(str_match(lines[doc_idx], "Document (\\d+) of")[, 2])

  # Headline: use the "Title:" field if present, otherwise the first
  # non-blank line after "Document X of 500"
  title_idx <- str_which(lines, "^Title:\\s*")[1]
  if (!is.na(title_idx)) {
    headline <- str_remove(lines[title_idx], "^Title:\\s*")
  } else {
    after    <- tail(lines, -doc_idx)
    headline <- after[str_trim(after) != ""][1]
  }
  headline <- str_squish(headline)

  # Publication year (optional, for the index)
  year_idx <- str_which(lines, "^Publication year:\\s*")[1]
  year <- if (is.na(year_idx)) NA_character_ else
    str_squish(str_remove(lines[year_idx], "^Publication year:\\s*"))

  # Full text section: from "Full text:" to the line before "Subject:"
  ft_start <- str_which(lines, regex("^Full text:", ignore_case = TRUE))[1]
  if (is.na(ft_start)) {
    return(tibble(article_nmbr = doc_num, Year = year, headline = headline,
                  status = "no full text", body = list(NULL)))
  }

  subj    <- str_which(lines, regex("^Subject:", ignore_case = TRUE))
  ft_end  <- subj[subj > ft_start][1]
  status  <- "ok"
  if (is.na(ft_end)) {               # no Subject: line -> take rest of article
    ft_end <- length(lines) + 1
    status <- "ok (no Subject: line, took text to end of article)"
  }

  body    <- lines[ft_start:(ft_end - 1)]
  body[1] <- str_remove(body[1], regex("^Full text:\\s*", ignore_case = TRUE))

  # trim leading/trailing blank lines
  keep <- which(str_trim(body) != "")
  body <- if (length(keep)) body[min(keep):max(keep)] else character(0)

  tibble(article_nmbr = doc_num, Year = year, headline = headline,
         status = status, body = list(body))
}
```


# run the extraction
```{r}

# This is the function, run to import and use
make_TidyTexts <- function(textfile,
                           source_dir = "source_demo",
                           out_dir    = "extracted_demo") {

  article_path <- file.path(source_dir, textfile)
  dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  # Read the export and number the articles at each underscore line
  TEXT <- tibble(Text = read_lines(article_path)) %>%
    mutate(Text       = str_remove(Text, "\\s+$"),
           is_sep     = str_detect(Text, "^_{20,}$"),
           newarticle = cumsum(is_sep)) %>%
    filter(newarticle > 0, !is_sep)   # drop anything before the first article

  # Extract every article
  articles <- TEXT %>%
    group_split(newarticle) %>%
    map(~ extract_one(.x$Text)) %>%
    compact() %>%
    bind_rows()

  # Build unique, safe file names from the headlines
  articles <- articles %>%
    mutate(file_base = safe_filename(headline),
           file_base = if_else(is.na(file_base) | file_base == "",
                               paste("Document", article_nmbr), file_base)) %>%
    group_by(file_base) %>%
    mutate(file_base = if (n() > 1) paste0(file_base, " (Doc ", article_nmbr, ")")
                       else file_base) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(file = file.path(out_dir, paste0(file_base, ".txt")))

  # Write each article's full text
  to_write <- articles %>% filter(str_starts(status, "ok"))
  walk2(to_write$body, to_write$file,
        ~ write_lines(.x, .y))

  # Save an index of what was extracted
  index <- articles %>%
    mutate(file = if_else(str_starts(status, "ok"), file, NA_character_),
           n_lines = map_int(body, length)) %>%
    select(article_nmbr, Year, headline, file, status, n_lines)

  write_csv(index, file.path(out_dir, "_index.csv"))

  message(sum(str_starts(index$status, "ok")), " of ", nrow(index),
          " articles written to ", out_dir, "/")
  if (any(!str_starts(index$status, "ok"))) {
    message("Articles without a full text section: ",
            paste(index$article_nmbr[!str_starts(index$status, "ok")], collapse = ", "))
  }

  invisible(index)
}
```



```{r}
make_TidyTexts_all <- function(source_dir = "source_demo", out_dir = "extracted_demo") {
  
  # Find all .txt files in the source directory
  files <- list.files(path = source_dir, pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = FALSE)
  
  if (length(files) == 0) {
    stop("No .txt files found in ", source_dir)
  }
  
  message("Found ", length(files), " file(s) to process: ", paste(files, collapse = ", "))
  
  # Loop through each file, run your original function, and collect the indices
  all_indices <- map(files, function(f) {
    message("\n---> Processing file: ", f)
    
    # Run your existing function on this file
    idx <- make_TidyTexts(f, source_dir = source_dir, out_dir = out_dir)
    
    # Add a column so you know which original source file each article came from
    idx %>% mutate(source_file = f)
  }) %>% bind_rows()
  
  # Save a combined master index spreadsheet
  master_index_path <- file.path(out_dir, "_master_index.csv")
  write_csv(all_indices, master_index_path)
  
  message("\n==============================")
  message("All files processed! Master index saved to: ", master_index_path)
  message("==============================")
  
  invisible(all_indices)
}
```

```{r}
master_index <- make_TidyTexts_all()
```

#streamlined

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# 1. Clean filenames safely for OS limits
safe_filename <- function(x, max_chars = 150) {
  x %>%
    str_replace_all('[\\\\/:*?"<>|\\r\\n\\t]', " ") %>%
    str_squish() %>%
    str_sub(1, max_chars) %>%
    str_remove("[ .]+$")
}

# 2. Extract a single article from text lines
extract_one <- function(lines) {
  doc_idx <- str_which(lines, "^\\s*Document \\d+ of \\d+")[1]
  if (is.na(doc_idx)) return(NULL)
  
  doc_num <- as.integer(str_match(lines[doc_idx], "Document (\\d+) of")[, 2])

  title_idx <- str_which(lines, "^Title:\\s*")[1]
  headline <- if (!is.na(title_idx)) {
    str_remove(lines[title_idx], "^Title:\\s*")
  } else {
    after <- tail(lines, -doc_idx)
    after[str_trim(after) != ""][1]
  }
  headline <- str_squish(headline)

  year_idx <- str_which(lines, "^Publication year:\\s*")[1]
  year <- if (is.na(year_idx)) NA_character_ else {
    str_squish(str_remove(lines[year_idx], "^Publication year:\\s*"))
  }

  ft_start <- str_which(lines, regex("^Full text:", ignore_case = TRUE))[1]
  if (is.na(ft_start)) {
    return(tibble(article_nmbr = doc_num, Year = year, headline = headline,
                  status = "no full text", body = list(NULL)))
  }

  subj <- str_which(lines, regex("^Subject:", ignore_case = TRUE))
  ft_end <- subj[subj > ft_start][1]
  status <- "ok"
  
  if (is.na(ft_end)) {
    ft_end <- length(lines) + 1
    status <- "ok (no Subject: line, took text to end of article)"
  }

  body <- lines[ft_start:(ft_end - 1)]
  body[1] <- str_remove(body[1], regex("^Full text:\\s*", ignore_case = TRUE))

  keep <- which(str_trim(body) != "")
  body <- if (length(keep)) body[min(keep):max(keep)] else character(0)

  tibble(article_nmbr = doc_num, Year = year, headline = headline,
         status = status, body = list(body))
}

# 3. Core processor for any given text file
process_text_file <- function(file_path, out_dir) {
  TEXT <- tibble(Text = read_lines(file_path)) %>%
    mutate(Text = str_remove(Text, "\\s+$"),
           is_sep = str_detect(Text, "^_{20,}$"),
           newarticle = cumsum(is_sep)) %>%
    filter(newarticle > 0, !is_sep)

  TEXT %>%
    group_split(newarticle) %>%
    map_dfr(~ extract_one(.x$Text))
}

# 4. Master wrapper: handles single files or entire folders automatically
make_TidyTexts <- function(target = "source_demo", out_dir = "extracted_demo") {
  dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  # Determine if target is a specific file or a folder to batch-process
  files <- if (dir.exists(target)) {
    list.files(path = target, pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
  } else if (file.exists(target)) {
    target
  } else {
    stop("Target '", target, "' is neither a valid file nor directory.")
  }

  if (length(files) == 0) stop("No .txt files found to process.")

  # Process all target files and bind results
  all_articles <- map_dfr(files, function(f) {
    message("Processing: ", basename(f))
    process_text_file(f, out_dir) %>% mutate(source_file = basename(f))
  })

  # Handle duplicate headlines & assign unique safe filenames cleanly
  all_articles <- all_articles %>%
    mutate(
      file_base = safe_filename(headline),
      file_base = if_else(is.na(file_base) | file_base == "", paste("Document", article_nmbr), file_base)
    ) %>%
    group_by(file_base) %>%
    mutate(file_base = if (n() > 1) paste0(file_base, " (Doc ", article_nmbr, ")") else file_base) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(file = if_else(str_starts(status, "ok"), file.path(out_dir, paste0(file_base, ".txt")), NA_character_))

  # Write out valid article text files
  to_write <- all_articles %>% filter(!is.na(file))
  walk2(to_write$body, to_write$file, ~ write_lines(.x, .y))

  # Build and save index
  index <- all_articles %>%
    mutate(n_lines = map_int(body, length)) %>%
    select(source_file, article_nmbr, Year, headline, file, status, n_lines)

  index_name = if (dir.exists(target)) "_master_index.csv" else paste0("_index_", sub("\\.txt$", "", basename(target)), ".csv")
  index_path <- file.path(out_dir, index_name)
  write_csv(index, index_path)

  message("\nDone! ", sum(str_starts(index$status, "ok")), " of ", nrow(index), 
          " articles written to ", out_dir, "/ (Index saved as ", index_name, ")")

  invisible(index)
}
```

```{r}
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
#                    Turning Articles into TidyText                            #
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------#

# This is the function, run to import and use
make_TidyTexts <- function(textfile){

#load the article into function environment
article <- paste0("source/",textfile)

#rename textfile (removes .txt to make saving easier)
textfile <- gsub('.{4}$','',textfile)

TEXT <- read_lines(article)
TEXT <-as.data.frame(TEXT)


# another method Rename a specific column
colnames(TEXT)[1] <- "Text"


#Replace this text string with "STARTOFARTICLE"
TEXT$Start <- 
  gsub("____________________________________________________________", 
       "STARTOFARTICLE", TEXT$Text)


#Create an index, numbering each line per article.
TEXT <- TEXT %>%
  mutate(linenumber = row_number(),
         newarticle = cumsum(str_detect(Start, regex("STARTOFARTICLE", 
                                                     ignore_case = TRUE, na.rm=TRUE)))) %>%
  ungroup()


#Delete blank cells
TEXT <- TEXT[!(is.na(TEXT$Start) | TEXT$Start==""), ]

#Table of Articles, Titles and Numbers
TEXT_Tidy_Headlines <- TEXT %>%
  select(Start, newarticle) %>%   
  filter(str_detect(Start, "Title: "))

colnames(TEXT_Tidy_Headlines)[1] <- "headline"
colnames(TEXT_Tidy_Headlines)[2] <- "article_nmbr"

#Extract headlines and years
#
TEXT_Years <- TEXT %>%
  select(Start, newarticle) %>%   
  filter(str_detect(Start, "Publication year: "))
#
TEXT_Years$Start <- str_remove(TEXT_Years$Start, "Publication year: ")
colnames(TEXT_Years)[1] <- "Year"
colnames(TEXT_Years)[2] <- "article_nmbr"

Text_Headlines_Year <- TEXT_Tidy_Headlines %>% 
  inner_join(TEXT_Years) %>% 
  select(Year, headline, article_nmbr)

write.csv(Text_Headlines_Year,paste0("TidyTexts/",textfile,"_tidy.csv"))
```
